observed_behavior: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 requires that a user interface component receiving keyboard focus is not entirely hidden by author-created content. Note 1 limits testing of user-movable content in configurable interfaces to its initial positions. Note 2 says user-opened content may obscure the focused component without it being considered visually hidden when the user can reveal it without moving keyboard focus forward.
context: WCAG 2.2 W3C Recommendation, 12 December 2024; exact criterion 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum); focused W07 B1 K3 normative extraction. Level AA; requirement and associated W3C notes/conditions only.
limitations: Minimum (AA) prohibits entire author-created obscuration, not every degree of overlap; 2.4.12 Enhanced (AAA) separately addresses any partial obscuration.
User-configured movable content is evaluated at its initial position for this criterion.
User-opened content has the specific reveal-without-advancing-focus note; do not misrepresent it as a blanket exception for all overlays.
No sticky header, modal layer, focused component, or actual viewport was tested.
source_version_context: WCAG 2.2 W3C Recommendation, 12 December 2024; immutable dated Recommendation URL https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-WCAG22-20241212/; direct section #focus-not-obscured-minimum; retrieval 2026-10-08
